en.topic_title: 11% of primary and secondary school students have engaged in self-harming behaviour, study finds
en.topic_summary:
More than one in 10 Hong Kong primary and secondary school students have engaged in self-harm, a survey has found, with almost half saying school was their main source of stress.



Students in Hong Kong. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



Researchers behind the study, conducted by the Junior Chamber International Lion Rock and the Hong Kong Family Mediation Association (HKFMA), said students tie academic performance to their self-worth.
